body.condition: Conditional on the realized stage-1 recruitment history, \(\mathcal L((Z_{n2s})_{s:C_{n,s}(\rho)=1}\mid\mathcal F_{n,1}(\rho))=\bigotimes_{s:C_{n,s}(\rho)=1}\mathrm{Unif}\{z\in\{0,1\}^{N_{n2s}}:\sum_i z_i=m_{n2s}\}\), and no stage-2 assignment vector is generated when \(C_{n,s}(\rho)=0\).
